note: SOP CONTENT manifest (Corpus 5 / P4-03). This pins the ONE canonical SOP V2 library asset that 32-command-center-setup/scripts/ingest-sop-library.sh downloads, and the row population a fully-ingested box must reach.
count_derivation: The asset holds 2763 JSONL records / 2762 distinct slugs: the 2618 V2 records (2617 distinct slugs) from v10.13.29, carried verbatim, plus 145 department SOPs. ingest-sop-library.py keys every row on sop_ + sha256(slug) (U078), and sops.slug is UNIQUE, so a fully-ingested box holds exactly 2762 library rows (plus the CC starter seeds). 2762 is therefore the canonical population.
canonical_sample_note: U079: identifiers sampled FROM THIS ASSET (5 V2 records + 5 records new in v3). The ingester's skip gate requires every one to be present before it skips the download, so a box holding only the V2 library re-ingests v3, and a box already holding v3 skips (no re-download, no DB backup copy). Regenerate this sample from the asset whenever the asset is rebuilt; build_sop_library tests assert every entry exists in the pinned asset.
embeddings: SEPARATE CONCERN -- this manifest covers SOP CONTENT rows ONLY. Ingesting these rows makes ZERO embedding API calls and costs the client nothing. Vectors for this library are built ONCE centrally on the operator key and shipped via shared-utils/sop-embed-once/SOP-EMBEDDINGS-MANIFEST.json (provision_sop_embeddings.py is a sha256-verified download + sqlite import).
consumed_by: 32-command-center-setup/scripts/ingest-sop-library.sh (tag + sha256 hard gate + already-populated skip gate)
